The refuter was correct that the old example evaluated L(1,chi_4) by direct substitution into a series that had only been defined for Re(s)>1. The current example repairs that gap by invoking nonprincipal continuation before identifying the Gregory-Leibniz series.

The refuter was correct that the old parity-correction step reversed the required valuation adjustment. The current lemma repairs that by multiplying by M/ell, so every odd outside valuation is toggled while the prescribed classes on S stay fixed.

The refuter was correct that the old ternary Hasse-Minkowski proof invoked an unnamed classical descent without building the descended form. The current theorem repairs that by carrying out the |a|+|b| descent explicitly and lifting a zero of the smaller form back via norms.

The refuter was correct that the old global Hasse-Minkowski proof only referred to a missing matching argument. The current theorem repairs that by making the n=4 square-class patching and the n>=5 weak-approximation induction explicit on disk.

The refuter was correct that the old reciprocity proof skipped several generator pairs. The current theorem closes that nonfatal gap by checking (-1,2), (p,p), and the remaining exceptional cases directly from the local formulas plus the reciprocity supplements.

The refuter was correct that the old finite-prime exclusion broke for degenerate diagonal forms. The current theorem repairs that by separating the zero-coefficient case first and only then excluding primes for the nonzero diagonal case.

The refuter was correct that the old proof had no license to differentiate the Dirichlet-density asymptotic. The current theorem repairs that by proving the weighted sum through character averages and regularity of -L'/L at s=1 before the final Abel summation step.

The refuter was correct that the old odd-prime formula argued circularly in the alpha=beta=1 case. The current theorem repairs that by proving the four parity cases directly from the norm criterion, the odd-p square criterion, and Hensel lifting.

The refuter was correct that the old 2-adic formula proof only delegated the finite check to an external note. The current theorem repairs that by performing the mod-8 case analysis explicitly on current disk.

The refuter was correct that the old copier tile created a spurious ordinary-PCP match. The current lemma repairs that by dropping the self-matching copier and using only the special start tile, the ordinary shifted tiles, and the end tile.

The refuter was correct that the old undirected-path transfer was not an iff for the ordinary Hamiltonian path problem and depended on undeclared endpoint-labelled instances. The current corollary repairs that by making the endpoint-labelled path variants explicit and then reducing them to the ordinary path problems.

The refuter was correct that the old Hamiltonian-cycle reduction still left the variable gadget under-specified. The current theorem repairs that by naming the full crossbar graph, the boundary arcs, and the clause detours explicitly before the witness-direction arguments.

The refuter was correct that the old reduction could output the illegal SUBSET SUM target 0 at k=0. The current theorem repairs that by splitting off the k=0 yes-instance and k>n no-instance before the digit-column encoding.
